test_title: PYST 7: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Identify the sentence that uses the positive degree of comparison.

options.text: She is the most intelligent student in the class.
She is more intelligent than her classmates.
She is as intelligent as her classmates.
She is the more intelligent student in the class.

solution:
**The correct answer is option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**To answer this question, let's break down the degrees of comparison used in each option:**

__
 
• **Option 1: She is the most intelligent student in the class.**

 
 
• This sentence uses the **superlative degree** ("the most intelligent").
 
• It is used to compare one person with the whole group to show the highest quality.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: She is more intelligent than her classmates.**
 
 
• This sentence uses the **comparative degree** ("more intelligent than").
 
• It is used to compare two entities or a person against a group.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: She is as intelligent as her classmates.**
 
 
• This sentence uses the **positive degree** ("intelligent").
 
• The positive degree is the simplest form of the adjective. When used to show equality between two things, the **"as + adjective + as"** construction is used.
 
• This is the correct option__.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: She is the more intelligent student in the class.**
 __
 
• This sentence uses the **comparative degree** ("more intelligent").
 
• Though it uses "the," the word "more" indicates a comparison, typically used when referring to one of only two people.
 
 
 
• So, out of the given options, only Option 3 correctly identifies the use of the positive degree of comparison.__
 
• **Therefore, the correct answer is "She is as intelligent as her classmates."**
